speaker: Doctor
text: That is concerning given the growth over two months. Given your history of diabetes and age, could you describe the color, texture, or any specific borders of the lesion? Also, do you recall if you developed it from a sunburn or trauma?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Basal Cell Carcinoma.

The combination of a growing, painless, non-itchy chest lesion in a 63-year-old male with a history of diabetes is highly suggestive of basal cell carcinoma, though we must rule out melanoma or squamous cell carcinoma. Given the concerning growth pattern, I am requesting a full-body skin examination image and a plan for biopsy.
